name: Lufthansa
max_carrier_dimensions: Soft-sided, 55 x 40 x 23 cm (22 x 16 x 9 in), 118 cm total
checked_or_cargo: Yes: dogs and cats over 8 kg as excess baggage in the air-conditioned hold; other animals via Lufthansa Cargo.
banned_breeds: Special rules for 'fighting dog' breeds and snub-nosed breeds (see Lufthansa's dedicated pages). Pregnant animals not accepted.
banned_routes: New bookings for dogs to the USA only to Atlanta, Los Angeles, Miami, New York-JFK, Philadelphia, Washington DC, and Newark (if no high-risk rabies country in prior 6 months). Bookings may be refused on routes such as the UK, Ireland or Bangalore.
service_animal_note: Assistance dogs fly in the cabin free of charge; CDC requirements apply for the USA.

recent_changes.summary: After CDC dog-entry rule changes, Lufthansa accepts new dog bookings to the USA only to ATL, LAX, MIA, JFK, PHL and Washington DC.
Dogs to Newark (EWR) possible again if not in a high-risk rabies area in the prior 6 months.

notes: Minimum age 12 weeks (15 weeks to/from/via Germany; 6 months for dogs to the USA). Register at least 72 hours before departure (USA flights: online form only).
